pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the nsca daemon.

server_port.description: Port the nsca daemon listens on for incoming encrypted service check results.

bind_to_address.description: IP address to bind to (empty string binds to all interfaces).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections allowed.

command_file.description: Path to the Nagios external command pipe (must be writable by nsca user).

password.description: Shared secret used for encrypting/decrypting check results (must match the sender). Leave empty for no encryption (not recommended).

connection_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a complete message before dropping the connection (0 = no timeout).

child_timeout.description: Seconds to wait before killing a child process handling a request (0 = no timeout).

daemonize.description: Run nsca as a background daemon (true) or foreground (false).

debug_level.description: Verbosity of logging: 0 = none, 1 = errors, 2 = warnings, 3 = info, 4 = debug.

log_file.description: Path to log file. If empty, logs go to syslog instead.

allow_multiple_instances.description: Allow multiple nsca instances on the same host (requires unique ports/PIDs).

additional_hosts.description: List of allowed IP addresses or hostnames that may send service checks (leave empty to allow all — not recommended in production).

run_as_user.description: System user to run nsca as (must have write access to command_file).

run_as_group.description: System group to run nsca as.

umask.description: Umask for files created by nsca (e.g., PID file).
